entities.summary: Khalji, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with Delhi Sultanate (1206–1320). Their legacy influenced Razia Sultana rules as the only female sovereign of the Delhi Sultanate and Alauddin Khalji repels multiple Mongol invasions and conquers the Deccan.
